rationale: Bifidobacterium longum ferments glucose and arabinose via the bifidogenic pathway to acetate and lactate. Arginine provides both carbon and nitrogen. At t=0 with abundant fresh substrate, I commit to rapid growth (0.6/h) on preferred hexose and pentose sugars plus amino acid co-metabolism. Fermentation products (acetate, lactate, CO₂) are released. Carbon and nitrogen balance verified.
